lines.en: I drift through the air, slowly.
A trail of fire drags behind me.
My shell stands taller than a man.
The air shimmers with heat.
I circle the arena.
Two and a half times so far.
This is the first stage.
I fly low, hugging the ground.
Two balls of fire flank me.
They hit before I do.
I hover with my eye rolling.
What exactly are you waiting for?
I have waited far longer.
This shell is slowly burning.
The fire inside is held down.
The time has not yet come.

lines.zh: 我的火一明一暗，像在数数。
lines.en: My flames flicker like counting.
It is much slower than a man's.
The longer this drags, the worse it gets.
I raise my eyes to the sky.
There are old cracks in my shell.
Left from the last time.
It always grows back.

lines.zh: 我壳里的火压着，等它裂开。
lines.en: The fire in my shell waits for the moment it splits.
How long must we still wait?
Only a little more.
You stand in the middle of the arena.
I am circling you.
Your shadow starts to move.
That is my fire on it.
You have tightened your grip.
Gripping tighter will not help.
The edge of your armor is curling.
The cursed flame burns bright.
You are a dot in my eye.
That dot is getting brighter.
You turned your face away.
That was the right thing.
A line splits my shell.
A little of the fire inside escapes.
I force it back down.

lines.zh: 疼对我来说是另一种东西。
lines.en: Pain is another thing to me.
You landed a blow.

lines.zh: 裂缝里的火，替我记下了。
lines.en: The fire in my cracks remembers that for me.
This shell can take two more hits.

lines.zh: 我外壳上的裂缝在扩大。
lines.en: The crack in my shell is widening.
The second shell shows through.
That is the real me.
Keep that for yourself.

lines.zh: 我身上除了火，什么都没有。
lines.en: Apart from fire, I have nothing.
Do you mean to feed me?
My mouth is on fire.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西不会烤熟。
lines.en: That will not cook in your hand.
Unless you come near me.
I advise you not to.
It hits the ground and scorches first.
Things on the ground catch fire.
Look for yourself.
You hit my shell.
It burned you back.

lines.zh: 八千九百点血，两格多的眼睛。
lines.en: Eight thousand nine hundred health, and a two-block eye.
Try coming close again.
The heat made you jump away.
I heard you gasp.

lines.zh: 我贴近你，热气先烫到你。
lines.en: I come close and the heat reaches you first.
Your hand drew back.
I drift forward half a block.

lines.zh: 我的热气贴着你，退无可退。
lines.en: My heat presses on you—nowhere left to step.
Fire does not pair.
I have only one brother.
The two of us were once one.
Now we are apart.
We have been apart a long time.

lines.zh: 你问的对我来说太久远。
lines.en: What you ask is very far from me.
I am half of two.
The other half has not come.

lines.zh: 我们两个合起来才完整。
lines.en: Only together are we whole.

lines.zh: 你觉得这话对我有意义吗。
lines.en: Do you think those words mean anything to me.
What lies on the ground is scorched black.
The fire I spit is green.
It is of no use now.
What I touch catches fire.
Including those on the ground.
I descend and the fire lights it.
It blackens quickly.
I cannot put this hand out.
I have looked enough.
It turns to ash in my fire.
A line of fire trails behind me.
Now my turn has come.
My eye has fixed on you.
I have fought this fight many times.
An opponent like you is not common.
I do not mean to use full strength.
Not yet, anyway.
Your hands are hot.
That is my fire too close.
You shifted a step back.
That is not bad either.
I press forward a stretch.
The ground under you is scorched.
I pull the fire back.
You have a little time left.
I am waiting for the second stage.
Then you will understand.
You must last until then.

lines.zh: 我想看看你的极限，魔焰已经烧到边。
lines.en: I want to see your limit; cursed flame burns at the rim.
I am not pressed at all.
I turn rings around you.
The fire arrives first, then me.
Do not look at my eye.
It grows uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 你的护甲，正在被我烤热。
lines.en: Your armor is being baked by me.
That is no illusion.
I am roasting you slowly.
Little by little.
Until you cannot hold out.
Your breathing is already quick.

lines.zh: 这里的热气让你喘不过气。
lines.en: The heat here takes your breath.

lines.zh: 火先烤你，我在后头慢慢绕。
lines.en: The fire roasts you first; I circle slowly behind.
You want to come closer to me.
That is exactly what I want.
My fire burns strongest beside me.
You chose this.

lines.zh: 我的兄弟在哪，你不知道。
lines.en: Where my brother is, you do not know.
That is the real trouble.
I circle and burn as I go.

lines.zh: 我的第二层壳已经露出。
lines.en: My second shell is showing already.
I ram forward and the fire arrives first.
Your armor lights up at once.
I open my mouth; it is all fire.
That one bakes you back.
Come a little nearer.
The fire will wrap around you.
I come down from overhead.
The fire lands on your shoulder first.
Then comes this shell.
I slam into your shield.
The face of it goes red.
This one you will not block.
Your shield came loose.
I lower my own body.
The arena floor splits.
Two balls of fire rise from it.
I open my eye.
The air turns dry at once.

lines.zh: 我的火升起来了，你站得稳吗？
lines.en: My fire rises—can you keep your footing?
None of this has begun.

lines.zh: 我浮在离地一格的地方。
lines.en: I hang a block above the ground.
Two balls of fire circle the arena.
They are my hands.
You need not look for my brother.
He will come.
When you can barely stand.
We always work together.
This fight belongs to two.
You think you face only one.
So much the better.
I have waited long for this.
The pattern on the floor lights up.

lines.zh: 我落定的时候，地面还在响。
lines.en: The ground still rings as I settle.
Dust rises as I land.

lines.zh: 我的火和我同源，烧不到我。
lines.en: This fire is my own; it cannot burn me.

lines.zh: 我从半空坠下去，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I drop out of the air and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 水浇在外壳上，整片冒白烟。
lines.en: Water hits my shell and the whole of it steams.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的壳掀开一角。
lines.en: The blast lifts a corner of my shell.

lines.zh: 一支箭撞上壳面，烧成灰。
lines.en: An arrow strikes the shell and burns to ash.
That spell presses my fire down.
I do not eat; I burn myself.
Lightning strikes the shell and sparks scatter.
Beneath the shell there is nothing.
